shorts_extract.hook: Leaving the psychoanalytic couch empty, Aaron Beck maps a patient's hidden half-second 'automatic thought' onto a two-column pad.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Beck's 1963 50-vs-31 clinical study uncovering the Negative Cognitive Triad (Self, World, Future) and five classic thinking distortions.
shorts_extract.twist: How Beck disproved his own Freudian dream theory and built CBT's 'collaborative empiricism' — not blind positive thinking.
